title: Aster record retention
text: The Aster archive keeps purchase receipts for seven years. After that period, receipts are deleted in the monthly cleanup.

title: Birch return window
text: The Birch equipment desk accepts unused keyboard returns within fourteen days of delivery. Return shipping is prepaid.

title: Cedar support hours
text: The Cedar support desk opens at nine in the morning and closes at five in the afternoon on weekdays. Weekend support is unavailable.

title: Dahlia dispatch location
text: Dahlia replacement sensors are dispatched from the Pune warehouse. The Mumbai office handles invoices but stores no replacement sensors.

title: Elm backup schedule
text: The Elm reporting database takes a full backup every Sunday. Incremental backups run every night.

title: Fern expense approval
text: At Fern, travel expenses above five thousand rupees require approval from the finance manager. Team leads approve smaller amounts.

title: Ginkgo account recovery
text: Ginkgo users recover a locked account by contacting the help desk. Recovery requests require the employee badge number. Passwords are never requested.

title: Hazel storage temperature
text: Hazel test cartridges must be stored between two and eight degrees Celsius. Do not freeze the cartridges.

title: Iris record retention
text: The Iris archive retains visitor logs for ninety days. Purchase receipts are stored in a separate archive.

title: Juniper return procedure
text: The Juniper equipment desk requires a return authorization code before an opened monitor can be shipped back. The code is issued by the service coordinator.

title: Kelp weekend service
text: The Kelp support desk provides weekend service between ten in the morning and two in the afternoon. Weekday requests use a separate queue.

title: Linden dispatch location
text: Linden repair kits leave from the Kochi depot. The Chennai warehouse only stores packaging supplies.

title: Maple restore checks
text: After a Maple database restoration, the reliability engineer must verify row counts before reopening the reporting dashboard.

title: Nettle expense deadline
text: Nettle staff must submit meal reimbursement claims within thirty days of the purchase. Late claims require director approval.

title: Olive recovery method
text: Olive account recovery uses a one-time link sent to the registered work email address. The link expires after twenty minutes.

title: Pine storage restriction
text: Pine calibration weights are kept in a dry cabinet on the second floor. They must not be stored near the wash station.

title: Aster guest log
text: The Aster reception desk retains guest logs for thirty days. This schedule does not apply to purchase receipts.

title: Birch monitor warranty
text: Birch monitors carry a two-year warranty. The warranty covers display defects but does not change the unused keyboard return window.

title: Fern vendor invoices
text: Fern vendor invoices above five thousand rupees are reviewed by the procurement officer. Employee travel follows the finance approval policy.

title: Olive password rotation
text: Olive service account passwords are rotated every sixty days. Interactive user recovery uses the registered email address.

title: Hazel transport containers
text: Hazel shipping containers can be reused after inspection by the lab technician. Containers and test cartridges have different storage instructions.

title: Linden packaging orders
text: Linden packaging supplies are ordered from the Chennai warehouse. The repair kit distribution location is separate.

title: Iris receipt archive
text: Iris purchase receipts are retained for eight years in the finance archive. Visitor logs follow the reception policy.

title: Maple backup notification
text: The Maple backup scheduler emails the operations coordinator every morning. Restoration validation is a separate reliability task.
